I: EDA

# Arrange 2x2 plotting window
par(mfrow = c(2,2))
par(mar = c(5, 16, 3, 1))

type_prop <- prop.table(table(planes$type))

barplot(type_prop,
        col = "steelblue",
        main = "Proportion of Aircraft Type",
        xlab = "Proportion",
        las = 1,
        horiz = TRUE)

model_lump <- forcats::fct_lump(factor(planes$model), n = 10)
model_prop <- prop.table(table(model_lump))

barplot(model_prop,
        col = "tomato",
        main = "Proportion of Aircraft Model",
        xlab = "Proportion",
        las = 1,
        horiz = TRUE)

manu_lump <- forcats::fct_lump(factor(planes$manufacturer), n = 10)
manu_prop <- prop.table(table(manu_lump))

barplot(manu_prop,
        col = "darkseagreen",
        main = "Proportion of Manufacturer",
        xlab = "Proportion",
        las = 1,
        horiz = TRUE)

engine_prop <- prop.table(table(planes$engine))

barplot(engine_prop,
        col = "gold",
        main = "Proportion of Engine Type",
        xlab = "Proportion",
        las = 1,
        horiz = TRUE)

weather:

# Histograms for quantitative variables in weather dataset
# temp       = Temperature (F)
# dewp       = Dewpoint (F)
# humid      = Relative humidity
# wind_speed = Wind speed (mph)
# wind_gust  = Wind gust speed (mph)
# precip     = Precipitation (inches)
# pressure   = Sea level pressure (millibars)
# visib      = Visibility (miles)
# hour       = Hour of recording (UTC)

par(mfrow = c(3,3))
par(mar = c(4,4,2,1))

hist(weather$temp,
     main = "Temperature",
     xlab = "Temp (F)",
     col = "skyblue",
     breaks = 30)

hist(weather$humid,
     main = "Humidity",
     xlab = "Relative Humidity",
     col = "gold",
     breaks = 30)

hist(weather$wind_speed,
     main = "Wind Speed",
     xlab = "Wind Speed (mph)",
     col = "tomato",
     breaks = 30)

hist(weather$wind_gust,
     main = "Wind Gust",
     xlab = "Wind Gust (mph)",
     col = "orchid",
     breaks = 30)

hist(weather$precip,
     main = "Precipitation",
     xlab = "Precipitation (inches)",
     col = "steelblue",
     breaks = seq(0, max(weather$precip, na.rm = TRUE), by = 0.01))

hist(weather$pressure,
     main = "Pressure",
     xlab = "Pressure (millibars)",
     col = "gray70",
     breaks = 30)

hist(weather$visib,
     main = "Visibility",
     xlab = "Visibility (miles)",
     col = "tan",
     breaks = 30)

hist(weather$hour,
     main = "Recording Hour",
     xlab = "Hour (UTC)",
     col = "cyan",
     breaks = 24)

par(mfrow = c(1,1))

# Departure Delay Distribution barplot

# Filter out extreme departure delays to give readers a closer look at distribution for most cases (> 400 minutes)
# This helps keep the histogram readable and avoids long-tail distortion.
flightsDistribution_dep <- flights %>%
  filter(dep_delay <= 400)

# Create histogram of departure delays using 15-minute bins
ggplot(flightsDistribution_dep, aes(x = dep_delay)) +
  geom_histogram(
    # Define custom bin boundaries from -30 to 400 in 15-minute increments
    breaks = seq(-30, 400, by = 15),
    color = "black",      # Outline color for bars
    fill = "steelblue"    # Fill color for bars
  ) +
  # Set x-axis tick marks every 30 minutes for readability
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-15, 400, by = 30)) +
  # Add plot title and axis labels
  labs(
    title = "Departure Delay Distribution (15-minute bins)",
    x = "Departure Delay (minutes)",
    y = "Count of Flights"
  ) +
  # Minimal theme for clean appearance
  theme_minimal()

II: Data Wrangling

# Start with flights
flights <- nycflights23::flights

# Prepare weather variables
weather <- nycflights23::weather %>%
  select(
    origin, month, day, hour, time_hour,
    temp, humid, wind_dir, wind_speed, wind_gust,
    precip, pressure, visib
  )

# Join weather to flights using airport + full time identifiers
flights2 <- flights %>%
  left_join(
    weather,
    by = c("origin", "month", "day", "hour", "time_hour")
  )

# Drop flight year before joining planes, so planes$year becomes aircraft year
flights2 <- flights2 %>%
  select(-year)

# Prepare planes
planes <- nycflights23::planes %>%
  filter(!is.na(year))

# Join planes to flights2 using tailnum
flights3 <- flights2 %>%
  left_join(
    planes,
    by = "tailnum"
  )

# Filter and clean variables
flights3 <- flights3 %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(dep_delay),
    !is.na(wind_dir),
    !is.na(wind_speed),
    !is.na(wind_gust)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    model = ifelse(is.na(model), "Unknown", model),
    type = ifelse(is.na(type), "Unknown", type),
    manufacturer = ifelse(is.na(manufacturer), "Unknown", manufacturer),

    plane_year = ifelse(
      is.na(year),
      median(year, na.rm = TRUE),
      year
    ),

    model = as.factor(model),
    type = as.factor(type),
    manufacturer = as.factor(manufacturer),

    model = fct_lump_min(
      model,
      min = 100,
      other_level = "Other Models"
    ),

    dep_delayed = ifelse(dep_delay > 15, 1, 0)
  )

III GLM and Performance of different models Base model:

# Model 1: Baseline Temporal Model
model1 <- glm(
  dep_delayed ~ hour,
  data = flights3,
  family = binomial
)

summary(model1)

  dep_delayed ~ carrier + origin + hour + month +
    temp + humid + wind_speed + precip + visib,
  data = flights3,
  family = binomial
)

  dep_delayed ~ carrier + origin + hour + month +
    temp + humid + wind_speed + precip + visib +
    model,
  data = flights3,
  family = binomial
)

flights <- nycflights23::flights %>%
  select(year, month, day, dep_delay, dep_time, arr_delay, arr_time, origin) %>% # dep-time and arr-time are saved here in case we want to do an investigation on statistics of what time section of the day has the most possibility of delay
  mutate(
    flight_date = make_date(year, month, day) # date compressed into format yyyy-mm-dd using year, month, day columns, more precise to view
  )

flights_cat <- flights %>%
  mutate(
    month = month(flight_date),
    time_period = case_when(
      dep_time >= 500 & dep_time < 1200 ~ "Morning",
      dep_time >= 1200 & dep_time < 1700 ~ "Afternoon",
      dep_time >= 1700 & dep_time < 2100 ~ "Evening",
      TRUE ~ "Night"
    ),
    time_period = factor(time_period,
                         levels = c("Morning", "Afternoon", "Evening", "Night")),
    delayed = dep_delay > 15
  )

delay_by_time <- flights_cat %>%
  group_by(time_period) %>%
  summarise(
    delay_rate = mean(delayed),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

delay_by_time <- delay_by_time %>%
  mutate(delay_rate = round(delay_rate, 2))

ggplot(delay_by_time, aes(x = time_period, y = delay_rate, fill = time_period)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_grey(start = 0.9, end = 0.1) +
  labs(
    title = "Departure Delay Rate (>15 min) by Time Period of Day (All NYC Airports)",
    x = "Time Period",
    y = "Delay Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ROC:

model2 <- glm(
  dep_delayed ~ carrier + origin + hour + month +
    temp + humid + wind_speed + precip + visib,
  data = flights3,
  family = binomial,
  na.action = na.exclude
)

model3 <- glm(
  dep_delayed ~ carrier + origin + hour + month +
    temp + humid + wind_speed + precip + visib +
    model,
  data = flights3,
  family = binomial,
  na.action = na.exclude
)

prob1 <- predict(model1, type = "response")
prob2 <- predict(model2, type = "response")
prob3 <- predict(model3, type = "response")

roc1 <- roc(flights3$dep_delayed, prob1)
## Setting levels: control = 0, case = 1
## Setting direction: controls < cases
roc2 <- roc(flights3$dep_delayed, prob2)
## Setting levels: control = 0, case = 1
## Setting direction: controls < cases
roc3 <- roc(flights3$dep_delayed, prob3)
## Setting levels: control = 0, case = 1
## Setting direction: controls < cases
auc(roc1)
## Area under the curve: 0.6377
auc(roc2)
## Area under the curve: 0.7093
auc(roc3)
## Area under the curve: 0.7118
plot(roc1,
     col = "blue",
     main = "ROC Curves for Logistic Regression Models")

plot(roc2,
     col = "red",
     add = TRUE)

plot(roc3,
     col = "darkgreen",
     add = TRUE)

legend("bottomright",
       legend = c(
         paste("Model 1 AUC =", round(auc(roc1), 3)),
         paste("Model 2 AUC =", round(auc(roc2), 3)),
         paste("Model 3 AUC =", round(auc(roc3), 3))
       ),
       col = c("blue", "red", "darkgreen"),
       lwd = 2)

# Quantitative variables

  filter(Var1 != Var2)

# Correlation bubble plot

  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black") +
  scale_size(range = c(1, 10)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation Plot of Quantitative Predictors",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    size = "|Correlation|",
    fill = "Correlation"
  )

Machine Learning:

ml_vars <- c(
  "arr_delay",
  "dep_delay",
  "carrier",
  "origin",
  "hour",
  "month",
  "temp",
  "humid",
  "wind_speed",
  "precip",
  "visib"
)

ml_data <- flights3[, ml_vars]

ml_data <- na.omit(ml_data)

x <- model.matrix(
  arr_delay ~ dep_delay + carrier + origin +
    hour + month + temp + humid +
    wind_speed + precip + visib,
  data = ml_data
)[, -1]

y <- ml_data$arr_delay

set.seed(123)

lasso_cv <- cv.glmnet(
  x = x,
  y = y,
  alpha = 1,
  nfolds = 5
)
